findings.detail: The NMG Holdings corporate bond row contains an 8.50% coupon in the source instrument text, but the extracted interest_rate is blank.

rationale: C01 is an aggregate debt-rate coverage flag. The current SOI table has an Interest Rate heading and the extracted artifact reports 5 of 12 debt rows without rates. At least one missing-rate debt row is source-decided: the NMG Holdings Co., Inc. corporate bond source row explicitly includes '8.50 %' in the instrument text while the extracted holding for that same issuer/maturity has blank interest_rate. That makes the flag a real extraction gap rather than a false alarm.
